integrity_statement: Fourier ranks are computed from unnormalized irreducible matrices. The full lower bounds follow from explicit representation algebra, three triple-support orbits, and a parity obstruction, not from finite random sampling. Earlier general inequalities were checked for implications but do not directly yield the claimed exact profile. No claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers the dihedral group of order eight and exact spatial supports, over real or complex scalars; it does not classify all minimizers or other finite groups.
title: Exact real and complex Fourier uncertainty on the dihedral group of order eight
